review: The strongest beer bottle thrower is finally here, and she did not disappoint! Her gameplay revolves around switching states on her Eye of Precognition relic while also being a Tremor and Burn Identity (not Poise keyword-wise, unfortunately) BUT mainly Tremor, especially with her absurd amount of Tremor Burst. Let’s take a look deeper into her kit! Starting with her 6 unique statuses: - Eye of Precognition - Interacts with her dodge mechanics, starting at 30 stacks and loses it on clash, base skill use, and activating her Precognition skill. Now, fortunately or unfortunately, depending on the context, she can only lose up to a maximum of 10 stacks per turn, so she would need a total of 3 turns at best to use 30 stacks fully.
